messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: some customers are seeing inconsistent similarity scores and slower embedding responses. Need marketing to advise on statuspage copy, webinar registrant messaging, and inbound lead gating. Thoughts?

ken: Engineering update: root cause appears to be a sharded KV cache rollout hitting corner-case collisions. We've started a rollback and traffic is being routed to the stable path. ETA ~30	60m for validation.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-embeddings-shard-regression created by ken.

priya: Recommend two status variants: 1) customer-friendly brief for statuspage and product banner, 2) a technical note for enterprise account teams and the support KB. Also hold any benchmark/launch posts until we're green.

priya: Customer-facing status suggestion: "Were investigating degraded performance for some embedding and similarity requests. Our engineers are rolling back a recent cache change and routing traffic to a stable runtime. Next update in 30 minutes. If you run time-sensitive jobs, contact support@redwood.com."

priya: Enterprise/Account-team note (short): "Root cause: cache sharding regression. Mitigation: rollback and traffic reroute. We will validate with p95/p99 telemetry; offer priority handling if you have running jobs—please provide account and job IDs."

taylor: For the webinar at 16:00 PT: recommend we postpone the live similarity demo and send registrants a 1-line update with CTA to statuspage + an offer of a short recorded walkthrough. We should not push the live demo if it depends on embeddings.

sam: Sales ask: pause SFDC lead webhook and mute automated outreach for new trials for 2h. Route new signups to incident-routing@redwood.com and have SDRs monitor but not proactively engage. I'll trigger the pause once marketing OKs.

maria: Timeline proposal: send registrant note in 10m, publish statuspage entry in 15m (simple copy), hold social/benchmark posts and paid ads, pause SFDC webhook immediately. Enterprise email only after metrics are validated (~45	60m).

ken: Ops will post a "investigating" note in ~15m and follow with a "recovering" update once p95 latency improves for two consecutive validation windows. I'll confirm here when metrics look good.

priya: Also recommend tagging incoming tickets with "incident-embeddings" and a priority flag for Dedicated customers. That lets Success escalate quickly.

maria: Agreed. Priya, can you send the registrant copy now? Sam, confirm the webhook pause here when done. Taylor, update the webinar host brief to skip the live demo and cue the recorded content.

sam: Confirmed  SFDC webhook paused and routing to incident-routing@redwood.com. SDRs on standby in #incident-inbound.

incident-bot: SFDC webhook disabled by automation (webhook-manager).

priya: Registrant DM draft: "Update: today's session will skip any live demos that rely on real-time embeddings due to a platform issue. Well share a new time within 72 hours and post live updates at https://status.redwood.com."

maria: Perfect. Thanks everyone. Keep updates short here; I'll publish the status copy in 15m and confirm once posted. :pray:
